name: Brandy Fulton
paragraphs: I'm strong, funny, very smart, and a great mom. Even with all that, life still gets lifey. Struggles are real, and everyone goes through things. I want to laugh hard whenever possible and love everyone even harder. Life is too short not to.
I came to Hope House Guthrie seven days after having a baby, but I arrived alone. DHS had taken my children into care because of drug use and domestic violence.

Hope House Guthrie gave me safety while I found my way back to myself. I found love, friends, and a whole new family—a fellowship of people who have seen the dark depths of life and are putting their effort into a better future.

I'm proud to have returned to a job I loved before addiction took over my time. I have custody of my children again, and we live together in our own apartment. I'm no longer being hurt every day. I continue to focus on my kids and myself, and I'm working toward getting a car.

Hope House Guthrie gives people their lives back, or even a life they never dreamed of. If God puts it on your heart to help others or give back, supporting Hope House Guthrie helps both the residents and the whole Guthrie community.
quote: Hope House Guthrie gives people back their lives, or maybe even a life they never even dreamed about.
